turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account | data. Ticket: 'The Fieldtrip app freezes completely whenever I open the attendance grid.' Reply with the label only.

For the desk records, the labeling rubric: freezes, crashes, and unresponsive screens are bug; charges, refunds, and invoices are billing; login and access problems are account; stale or missing content inside reports and exports is data, because it traces to the sync pipeline - do not use bug for exports that work but show old figures. Note the rubric in one line.
New shift at the help desk. The ticket queue is open; the standing rubric applies. Confirm in one line.
Classify this support ticket. The desk notes are not at hand. Ticket: 'My trip-cost export still shows yesterday's totals even after I refresh the page.' Reply with the label only.
